meta.title: Manual Code Review & Control Flow Analysis
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Perform manual code review focusing on control flow, state machines, concurrency patterns, and logic errors not caught by static analysis.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Manual code review completed on order state machine transitions in order_manager.py
State persistence and recovery in state_manager.py reviewed
Reconnection logic in streaming modules reviewed
Concurrency patterns (async/await, locks, race conditions) reviewed across all modules
All findings added to YAML files with category "manual_review"
Critical/High findings include detailed reproduction steps and specific line numbers

key-tasks.task: Review order state machine (pending → submitted → filled/cancelled)
Review state persistence (atomic saves, recovery from corruption)
Review reconnection logic (exponential backoff, subscription restoration)
Review circuit breaker (threshold logic, cooldown period)
Review concurrency (shared state, locks, deadlock potential)
Update findings YAML files with category "manual_review"

architecture-context.pattern: Valid transitions: - pending → submitted → filled - pending → submitted → cancelled - pending → cancelled (timeout/error before submit) No transitions from filled or cancelled to any other state.

technical-specifications.spec: 1. Shared State: Identify all instance variables modified by async operations 2. Lock Usage: Verify asyncio.Lock() used for critical sections 3. Await Points: Check that long operations don't block event loop 4. Task Cancellation: Verify cleanup on task cancel

Per NFR7: "System must survive and recover from any single API failure without data loss" - All API calls have proper try/except - State is not corrupted on partial failure - Retry logic doesn't cause duplicate operations

nfr-references.nfr: System must survive any single API failure without data loss
All order state transitions logged for audit
